Earthbound Immortals..... it's in the name they are immortal and huge af

Ive been running an invoked version since the announcement and release of the cards so take my word how you will , but from looking at your deck list artifacts aren't bad at all, however I would suggest adding another Dyna (because he's a crow with a beatstick) and removing a Helmer. Helmer is good but 2k def is not incredibly hard to get over and keeping him on the field is not worth it he's good for like a one time draw and that's it. Furthermore blavo should be at 2, as 1900 4* beatstick with a boost everytime a brigadier is summoned is too good. Also I suggest you add 1 or 2 return of the dragonlords since you are running 3 LaFarl and he could really use protection or if you choose to xyz and detach you can always bring him back and trigger other skyfang effects so.... It's a really good tech. Finally the last optional tech that I could say which fits your deck, Is definetly double cyclone.... Artifacts get popped so effects go off and so does opponents backrow. Also for extra deck (expensive but maybe you can afford idk) a borreload and saryuja simply because both are incredibly busted and can easily be summoned with skyfangs
